PRACTICALITY MEETS RECREATIONAL CONVENIENCE WITH A SECOND ATTACHED GARAGE ON THE LOWER LEVEL, PROVIDING VALUABLE SPACE FOR LAWN EQUIPMENT, OUTDOOR GEAR, AND ALL YOUR FAVORITE RECREATIONAL TOYS. WHETHER YOU ENVISION A FULL-TIME HOME OR A SPACIOUS RETREAT, THIS DISTINCTIVE PROPERTY OFFERS A RARE COMBINATION OF GENEROUS LIVING SPACE, FLEXIBILITY, AND A REMARKABLE NATURAL SETTING. ONLY 7 MILES TO ELLICOTTVILLE.
